jobs.description:
Meta's Silicon Engineering team is building custom silicon infrastructure to power the next generation of AI and data center workloads at scale. The Infra Silicon Physical Design CAD team develops and scales the RTL-to-GDSII implementation and signoff flows that our designers use to tape out large, high-performance SoCs on leading-edge process nodes.As an ASIC Engineer for a Physical Design & Signoff CAD Engineer you will own and advance our implementation and signoff methodology from synthesis, place and route, and PPA optimization through timing, physical, and reliability signoff; to build the infrastructure and AI-assisted automation that makes these flows fast, reproducible, and scalable across many designs and teams.  
  
  

### **Physical Design & Signoff CAD Engineer Responsibilities:**

* Develop, deploy, and maintain the end-to-end RTL-to-GDSII physical design implementation flow, including synthesis, floorplanning, placement, CTS, routing, and PPA optimization
* Own and improve signoff methodology across static timing analysis, electromigration and IR drop analysis, physical verification, power analysis, logic equivalence checking, and SDC/UPF quality checks
* Support active tapeout programs on leading-edge process nodes, partnering with physical design, STA, and design teams to debug flow and signoff issues and drive them to closure
* Build and extend CAD infrastructure: flow execution harnesses, run-tracking and QoR dashboards, and design release / version control systems
* Develop scalable, AI-assisted tooling to automate flow setup, triage, QoR analysis, and optimization decisions
* Qualify new tool versions, technology collateral, and reference methodologies from EDA vendors and foundry partners
* Document methodology and enable designers through training, office hours, and support
* Collaborate with CAD, physical design, and silicon partner teams across multiple sites and time zones

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master'

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Python)
jobs.description:
Our client is looking for a backend engineer to take full ownership of core features on their medical imaging platform. This isn't a role where you hand off your code at the pull request - you’ll be directly responsible for system correctness, production stability, and the integrity of clinical data that directly impacts patient care.

The data science team builds the machine learning models; your job is to build the robust, deterministic platform that powers them. You’ll spend your time designing scalable architectures, untangling concurrency edge cases, ensuring zero-downtime data migrations, and keeping legacy services stable while building their replacements.

### **What you will do:**

* **Core Backend Architecture:** Drive the technical direction of our Python/FastAPI ecosystem, from API design to background task distribution and production observability.
* **Data Integrity & Persistence:** Architect and evolve our PostgreSQL schemas. You’ll manage migrations, lock mechanisms, query tuning, and multi-tenant data isolation under strict HIPAA/PHI compliance.
* **Resilient Image Processing Pipelines:** Design asynchronous, event-driven pipelines handling heavy medical imaging files—from ingest and de-identification to model inference and result delivery.
* **Cross-Functional System Contracts:** Define clean, reliable API interfaces with frontend teams and establish clear model input/output contracts with data scientists.
* **Technical Records & Legacy Transition:** Maintain Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), run thorough design reviews, and reliably maintain our legacy TypeScript service through its planned sunset.

### **What you will need:**

* **Deep Systems & Backend Fundamentals:** 5+ years of software engineering experience with proven production ownership. While our current stack is Python and FastAPI, we care more about deep systems fundamentals (Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, C#, or TypeScript) than language familiarity.
* **Concurrency & Distributed Systems
